design_summary: The TUMU user-interface surface covers the always-visible inline player HUD, profile and class selection via D-pad, controller features (haptics and LED color), and the title-screen portal doorway that replaces the legacy press-START flow. Selection happens directly in the lobby arena rather than through menu overlays, and the HUD persists across all game states. Input rules are codified per game state across title, gameplay, and pause contexts.

standalone_designs.title: D-Pad & Menu Input Rules
standalone_designs.summary: Cross-cutting input contract defining what D-pad and menu buttons do in each game state: title screen (unlimited profile/class cycling), gameplay (class cycling rift-limited, no profile switching), pause menu, and profile-selection mode. Also specifies rift-status reset triggers on scene transition and quit-to-menu.

epics.title: Inline Player HUD & Selection Rework
epics.summary: Replace menu-based profile/class selection with an always-visible inline HUD at the bottom-center showing 1-4 panels for connected controllers. Players select profile (title only) and class (any state) directly via D-pad, with portal/ghost/poof VFX on class change. The old overlay-based selection system is removed and joining is now auto-on-connect. A small amount of dead-code cleanup remains.

epics.title: Portal Doorway (Title Screen)
epics.summary: Replace the press-START prompt with a magical stone portal doorway in the lobby arena that players walk into to start the game. Front/back-layer arch with keystone over a black void, a blue spiral that brightens and shoots rays when players gather, and a pull-in transition that shrinks and spins players into the void. Implemented in portal_doorway.gd and wired through title_screen.gd; the backlog checkboxes are stale relative to the shipped code.
